topic: CoffeeMan/Amigo rendered anonymous checkout: ₪20 one-8-pack cart quote with the destination selected
method: Fresh interactive headless Google Chrome 154.0.8037.97 + ChromeDriver 154.0.8037.92 session through scripts/browser-research.mjs. The anonymous one-8-pack cart was built from the real 8 × 250 g product page by invoking the page's own add-to-cart anchor (a.add-to-cart, label 'קנה עכשיו', onclick addme_cart('930335',…)) and then opening the public checkout (https://www.coffeeman.co.il/checkout.asp). For each selectable locality the closed home-delivery locality select (#hfd_cities) was set and the home-courier option in #delivery (value 200, label 'משלוח לבית הלקוח עם שליח  - 20.00 ₪') was selected; the rendered summary was read back. No order, payment, login, account creation or street address was involved. Cart/session identifiers, cookies and tokens are deliberately not recorded.
toolingLimitation: The coding agent's file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so no image-based visual claim is made. Every value below is backed by rendered DOM values and body text captured in the same live session.
cart: 1 × (8 × 250 g) = 2 kg, item subtotal ₪240.00 (no quantity promotion on this multipack)

deliverySelect.note: The option list did not change with the selected locality; the ₪20 home-courier option was selectable for every destination below.

observations.coverage: The observed ₪20 one-8-pack home-courier quote was re-applied unchanged (₪240 + ₪20 = ₪260) with the destination set to each of the five selectable localities. The quote is still scoped to carts up to 2000 g: a two-8-pack (4 kg) cart was never observed and stays unrankable.
observations.distributionCenter: The checkout also offered the ₪20 distribution-center option (value 203) for the same cart; it stays a display-only alternative and is not the ranked rate.
observations.threshold: The cart did not receive free delivery (the observed free carts remain the exact 7-singles, 8-singles and two-4-pack carts), so no free threshold is recorded or inferred.

conclusion: The ₪20 home-courier quote is destination-independent across the five selectable destinations for the one-8-pack cart. Money, quantity scope (max 2000 g) and the no-threshold rule are unchanged.
policyImpact: Provenance-only update of coffeeman-8pack-il-cart-quote (v3): the evidence note and observedFor destinations name the verified coverage; the read-time evaluator refreshes the evidence provenance on already-stamped rows.
